caption: Two heavy sacks sit on opposite ends of a level seesaw; one sack is dragged off its end, and the other end drops to the ground.

sa.check: Two sacks sit on opposite ends of a seesaw.
The seesaw is level at the start.
One sack is dragged off its end.
The other end drops to the ground.
The sack is dragged off first and the drop follows.

pc.expect: The drop happens as soon as the sack's weight leaves the seat, not before and not long after.
pc.fail: The beam stays level after one sack is gone; or the end drops before the sack has left it; or the still-loaded end rises.

pc.expect: The loaded end goes down to the ground and the emptied end rises at the same time.
pc.fail: Both ends go down; or the loaded end rises; or the beam floats level with only one sack on it.

pc.expect: The beam pivots about its centre, and the remaining sack rides down with its end and may slide toward the low end.
pc.fail: The beam slides off its pivot; or the sack slides uphill; or the sack lifts off the seat.

pc.expect: The beam stays rigid, and the sacks are heavy and floppy, sagging where they sit.
pc.fail: The beam bends like rubber; or a sack bounces high; or a sack stays rigid as a box.

pc.expect: Two sacks and one seesaw keep their number and shape.
pc.fail: A sack vanishes or a third appears; or a sack passes through the beam; or the seesaw turns into another object.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The sacks' colour, the seesaw and the ground stay the same.
pc.fail: A sack changes colour or size; or the seesaw changes length between frames; or the ground rearranges.
